# eclipse-debug

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 23.

Eclipse debugging tools for breakpoint management, debug session control, and runtime inspection

## addBreakpoint

Add a line breakpoint to a Java file with optional condition and hit count

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | Path to the file (relative or absolute) |
| lineNumber | string | int | Yes | Line number (1-based) |
| projectName | string | String | Yes | Optional project name for path resolution |
| condition | string | String | Yes | Optional breakpoint condition expression (e.g., 'userId == null') |
| hitCount | string | Integer | Yes | Optional hit count (breakpoint triggers after N hits) |

## createJavaLaunchConfiguration

Create a local Java Application, JUnit 4, JUnit 5, or TestNG launch configuration. The type can be explicit or auto-detected from resolved test annotations/imports. Existing names are rejected by default.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mainClass | string | String | Yes | Target Java class. For type='java' it must declare a main method; for test types it is the test class. Prefer a fully qualified name. |
| configName | string | String | No | Configuration name. Defaults to the target class simple name. |
| projectName | string | String | No | Optional Java project name. Inferred when the target class has exactly one workspace match. |
| programArguments | string | String | No | Optional program arguments exactly as they should appear on the command line. |
| vmArguments | string | String | No | Optional JVM arguments exactly as they should appear on the command line. |
| workingDirectory | string | String | No | Optional absolute or workspace-relative working directory. Defaults to the project directory. |
| environmentVariables | object | Map&lt;String, String&gt; | No | Optional object mapping environment variable names to string values. |
| appendSystemEnvironment | boolean | Boolean | No | Whether configured variables are appended to the native environment. Default: true. |
| nameConflict | string | String | No | Name collision policy: 'error' (default) or 'generate' to let Eclipse create a unique suffixed name. |
| type | string | String | No | Launch type: 'java' (default), 'junit4', 'junit5', 'testng', or 'auto'. Auto uses resolved annotations/imports and falls back to a main method. |

## evaluateExpression

Evaluate an expression in the current debug context (limited implementation - use getVariables for simple variable inspection)

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| expression | string | String | Yes | Expression to evaluate |
| stackFrameIndex | string | Integer | Yes | Index of the stack frame (0 = top, default 0) |

## getDebugStatus

Get the current debug session status including state, location, thread count, and breakpoint count

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## getLaunchConfiguration

Show the type, modes, Java launch attributes, working directory, and environment of a launch configuration. Environment values are hidden by default.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configName | string | String | Yes | Exact launch configuration name |
| includeEnvironmentValues | boolean | Boolean | No | If true, includes environment values, which may expose secrets. Default: false. |

## getStackTrace

Get the current stack trace with smart filtering to avoid overwhelming framework dumps

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| maxDepth | string | Integer | Yes | Maximum number of frames to return (default 10) |
| packageFilter | string | String | Yes | Only include frames from matching packages (e.g., 'com.example') |
| skipFramework | string | Boolean | Yes | Skip framework packages like java.&#42;, javax.&#42;, org.eclipse.&#42; (default true) |

## getVariables

Get local variables from a stack frame with their names, types, and values

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| stackFrameIndex | string | Integer | Yes | Index of the stack frame (0 = top, default 0) |

No parameters.

## listThreads

List all threads in the debug session with their state (running/suspended/stepping), current location if suspended, and which thread is focused

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sessionName | string | String | Yes | Optional debug session name (uses focused or first active session if omitted) |

## resume

Resume execution until next breakpoint or program termination (F8)

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## runDebug

Launch a debug configuration by name. Async by default with file logging. Use listDebugConfigurations to see available configurations.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configName | string | String | Yes | Name of the debug configuration |
| waitForCompletion | boolean | Boolean | No | If true, waits for the process to terminate (max 120s). Default: false |

## selectThread

Focus a thread by name for subsequent debug commands (step, getVariables, etc.). Pass empty threadName to reset to auto-select mode.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| threadName | string | String | Yes | Name of the thread to focus (e.g., 'main'). Empty to reset focus. |
| sessionName | string | String | Yes | Optional debug session name |

## stepInto

Step into the next method call (F5). Requires suspended debug session.

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## stepOver

Step over the current line (F6). Requires suspended debug session.

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## stepReturn

Step out of the current method (F7). Requires suspended debug session.

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## suspend

Suspend the current debug session to inspect state

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## terminate

Terminate the current debug session and stop the running program

Input schema type: object.

No parameters.

## updateLaunchEnvironment

Update environment variables for an existing launch configuration. Supports merging, full replacement, explicit removal, and native environment inheritance.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configName | string | String | Yes | Exact launch configuration name |
| variables | object | Map&lt;String, String&gt; | No | Optional object mapping variable names to string values to merge or use as the complete replacement. |
| removeVariables | array | List&lt;String&gt; | No | Optional array of variable names to remove in merge mode. |
| updateMode | string | String | No | Environment update mode: 'merge' (default) or 'replace'. |
| appendSystemEnvironment | boolean | Boolean | No | Optional native environment inheritance setting. Omit to keep the current value. |
